interface.longDescription: Experimental packaging of the AtlasSynapse Semantic Memory skill. Install alongside the existing AtlasSynapse Secure MCP Tunnel connector. This ZIP does not embed MCP tools — use the tunnel for the 18-tool agent surface. Do not treat this package as production directory distribution.
